tasks.title: Launch a container
tasks.instructions:
Launch an Ubuntu 24.04 container named `web`:

```bash
lxc launch ubuntu:24.04 web
```

Verify it's running:

```bash
lxc list
```
hints: If the image isn't cached yet, the first launch will download it — be patient.
tasks.solution:
```bash
lxc launch ubuntu:24.04 web
lxc list
```

tasks.title: Set resource limits
tasks.instructions:
Configure the `web` container with resource limits:

```bash
lxc config set web limits.cpu=1 limits.memory=256MiB
```

Verify the limits were set:

```bash
lxc config get web limits.cpu
lxc config get web limits.memory
```
hints: You can set multiple config values in a single lxc config set command.
lxc config get <name> <key> retrieves a single value.
tasks.solution:
```bash
lxc config set web limits.cpu=1 limits.memory=256MiB
lxc config get web limits.cpu
lxc config get web limits.memory
```

tasks.title: Verify limits inside the container
tasks.instructions:
Run commands inside the `web` container to verify the limits are in effect:

```bash
lxc exec web -- free -m
lxc exec web -- nproc
```

You should see approximately 256 MiB of memory and 1 CPU.
hints: free -m shows memory in megabytes — it should be close to 256.
nproc returns the number of available CPUs — it should be 1.
tasks.solution:
```bash
lxc exec web -- free -m
lxc exec web -- nproc
```
